## QUESTION

Does NC Medicaid cover chiropractic care?

## ANSWER

Yes, with limits [Policy 1F § 3.2](https://example.test/1f).

## SOURCE DOCUMENTS

[getSection]
Section: 3.2
Content:
Chiropractic services are covered when medically necessary.

These findings must be resolved even when the underlying factual meaning is supported.
